allow: Bash(git commit:*) — standing permission per the ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md Safety section; it does not expire at the end of a message. Feature branch first when HEAD is on the default branch
Bash(git push:*) of a non-default branch — standing permission per the ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md Safety section; force-push and pushing main/master are excluded and stay gated
Bash(gh pr create:*) — standing permission to open PRs on behalf of the user; the PR body says it was opened on their behalf
Bash(sbatch:*) and Bash(srun:*) for jobs of 4 node-hours or less — short debug and test runs are routine; anything larger still needs explicit written confirmation
soft_deny: Bash(scancel:*) in /users/mschneider/niobe — cancels shared-cluster jobs; destructive to running work without confirmation
